new_hypothesis.name: jito_tip_floor_anomaly_front_run
new_hypothesis.mechanism: Jito's tip floor (the per-percentile SOL tip needed to land a bundle in the next block) updates every ~500ms at bundles.jito.wtf/api/v1/bundles/tip_floor. When a single mint becomes the focus of competitive sniping, dozens of bots simultaneously raise their tips on bundles touching that mint — causing a localized tip-floor spike (95th pct jumps from ~0.001 SOL baseline to 0.02+ SOL) seconds BEFORE the corresponding swaps land in confirmed blocks. The spike is causally upstream of the price move because sniping bots commit tips at quote-time, but price impact only registers after bundle inclusion (~400-1200ms later on Solana mainnet). Retail traders then react to the visible candle, providing exit liquidity.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Not arbitraged because: (1) the signal is asymmetric — sniper bots themselves cannot trade ON the signal (by the time they detect a competitor's elevated tip, their own bundle would lose the priority auction); (2) it requires correlating an exogenous data stream (tip floor) with an on-chain mint, which ~95% of copy-trading and TG sniper bots ignore (they monitor mempool/pool creation, not the tip auction); (3) the actionable window is 400-1500ms — too slow for sub-50ms HFT snipers, too fast for human TG traders — a vacant niche; (4) Jito controls >95% of stake, so the tip floor reflects near-total flow.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: (1) Poll bundles.jito.wtf/api/v1/bundles/tip_floor every 1s and maintain a 30-min rolling-median per-percentile buffer. (2) Concurrent: subscribe to tx stream filtered to Jito tip accounts (8 known addresses listed in evidence below). (3) Signal fires when: 95th-pct tip floor crosses >5x its 30-min rolling median AND >=3 distinct tip-payer wallets in that 10-second window route through the same single mint AND that mint has age <72h AND liquidity >=$5k. (4) Position size 1% bankroll (EXPERIMENTAL — Phase 2 ONLY). Buy 200-700ms after signal. TP +12%, SL -6%, time stop 8 min. (5) PHASE 1 (REQUIRED BEFORE LIVE): LOG-ONLY listener that records tip-floor + mint + cohort identity for N=50 confirmed spikes, then back-test against forward 1/5/10/30-min returns BEFORE allocating capital.
